name: Privé
description: Secure password manager with sharing capabilities.
//_permissions_note: List of API access requirements for the extension to function correctly
//_host_permissions_note: Explicit URLs the extension is allowed to communicate with
//_csp_note: Defines script source limits and external font/style access

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com;

//_background_note: The background service worker that manages the vault session and auth logic
//_content_scripts_note: Scripts injected into web pages to detect login forms and handle autofill
//_externally_connectable_note: Allows the Privé website and localhost dev server to communicate directly with the extension
//_action_note: Primary popup configuration (the main extension interface)
//_icons_note: Extension icons used in the toolbar and Chrome Web Store
//_war_note: Resources like icons and styles accessible to injected content scripts
